snippet.title: Fight for Olympus Trailer (Steam)
snippet.description:
Trailer for my new PC card game Fight for Olympus, made with Unity. 

This single player game has over 250 cards to collect by defeating enemy hordes with superior tactics and well timed sorceries. You can also collect 40 different deck types with their own particular strategy and many card combo's.

Fight For Olympus has a somewhat different system from other deckbuilding card games:
-no separate resource cards;
-you can save up resources for later turns;
-you keep cards you draw;
-choose how to spend resources: draw more cards or play cards; 
-lane based, turn based combat.
